hypothesis: Reprogramming of somatic cells to a pluripotent state can be achieved through the introduction of specific transcription factors
prediction: Introduction of the four known stem cell regulators (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) into somatic cells will induce pluripotency in at least 1% of the treated cells
measurement_method: Quantification of pluripotency markers (e.g. SSEA-1, SSEA-3, Tra-1-60, Tra-1-81) by flow cytometry or immunofluorescence
falsification_condition: If less than 0.1% of treated cells exhibit pluripotency markers, or if the introduction of these transcription factors does not result in a significant increase in pluripotency markers compared to untreated controls
